title: Measure and propose a roofing job

what_happened: The original job was listed as a public Grok Bot prompt and copied onto really.bot for the directory, following a two-day roofing run that involved measuring a roof, building a proposal, staging a contract, and drafting change orders. This public version of the job is based on that run and generalizes the steps and tools used.
